## Problem and resulting behavior / المشكلة والنتيجة

## Validation / التحقق

Commands run, device/browser versions, results and meaningful limitations.
Use synthetic data in screenshots.

## Recovery and compatibility / التعافي والتوافق

Describe cancel/undo/original preservation, storage changes and rollback where relevant.
For changed published assets, include the new PWA cache version.

## Dependencies and attribution / المكتبات والحقوق

List new/changed dependencies or assets and their licenses; preserve notices.
Mention AI assistance where useful for provenance or review.
